Privately held McWane is based in Birmingham, AL, where it was founded in 1921. Wikipedia lists about 6,000 employees; the company's Form 5500 shows 5,266 participants in 2023, and JobsOhio's 2022 release lists 522 retained jobs at the Coshocton ductile pipe plant.

FMCSA lists Trans-States Express Inc as a Cincinnati, OH carrier. Size comes from the signals: an Inclusion Grant with 16 retained jobs and 19 Form 5500 participants in 2023; its website blocked the fetch (403).

The Hilsinger Company does business as Hilco Vision, based in Plainville, MA; JobsOhio's 2021 release covers its 200-job Fairfield plant. Its U.S. Form 5500 shows 482 participants in 2023, and with the Ohio plant and overseas units (news reports of German and other acquisitions), worldwide staff is likely over 500. No exact figure found; the 'Parent LLC' name points to a holding or investor structure (Houlihan Lokey advised on a 2023 deal) that was not confirmed.

Evans was founded in Chicago in 1947 and owns Savory Foods (OH) among plants in several states; Highlander Partners (Dallas private equity) has owned it since Aug 2019 as Benestar Brands, merged with Palmex in 2024 to form Monarca. Form 5500 shows 570 participants in 2023 and JobsOhio lists 126 retained Ohio jobs; no exact worldwide count found, so 500-4999 is a judgment near the 500 line.

The company site says TekniPlex is headquartered in Wayne, PA and employs 9,000 people worldwide; the U.S. Form 5500 alone shows 2,111 participants in 2015 and 3,245 in 2023. Owned by Genstar Capital since Oct 2017 (news reports), so the 2015 grant predates that owner; the 2015 worldwide count was not found.

BMW Financial Services NA, LLC is a U.S. finance subsidiary of Munich-based BMW AG, which Wikipedia lists at about 154,500 employees (2025); the subsidiary's own Form 5500 shows 3,134 participants in 2023 and JobsOhio lists 760 retained jobs at its Ohio service center. EDGAR shows only ABS filings for the subsidiary, and the BMW annual report could not be fetched, so the grade is C even though the bucket is not in doubt.

White Castle Management Co is an affiliate of family-owned White Castle, headquartered in Columbus; Wikipedia lists about 10,000 employees and says the chain was founded in Wichita, Kansas in 1921. The 2020-era count was not found, but the bucket is not close.

The company site says Humtown is a family-owned business started in 1959 as a pattern shop in Columbiana, OH; Humtown Additive is its 3D-printing arm. Form 5500 for the sponsor Humtown Pattern Company shows 78, 49 and 77 participants in 2015, 2019 and 2023.

The TruRebel site says Axis began as Logan Fabricators in Bellefontaine, OH in 1958, was run by the Oldiges family, and was bought in 2023 by Blue Skies Operating Corp. (a small holding company that also owns Valence Industrial, with plants in Sidney, OH and Lexington, KY) and moved to Sidney. The grant went to Axis at its Bellefontaine address as an Inclusion Grant with 7 retained jobs; either owner is under 100 employees, but the exact acquisition date relative to the grant was not found.
